name: chapter-end
title: Chapter End
description: The end card of a chapter: a 3px panel whose concentration lines surround a central paper plate, with the chapter line, the big SFX word (To be continued, or The end for a finished series) and a brush arrow in the reading direction (a check at the end of a series). Under it, the next chapter as a full-width button with its number, title and optional cover, or, when it is not out yet, the date in a stamp; then any actions the reader wants (back to the series, comments). Under the manga reading order (data-reading="rtl") the arrow points left. The panel pops in once.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/chapter-end". The next chapter is a link (href), a button (onSelect), or not out yet (no href and no onSelect: pass date and the card shows "Out on" in a stamp). Extra actions go in children. Reading order follows the nearest data-reading attribute (rtl for manga, ltr for western): the arrow turns and the arrow sits before the word. The title is a plain string, shown in the SFX face and allowed to wrap.

meta.tagline: The end card of a chapter: to be continued, and the next chapter.
meta.usage:
import { ChapterEnd } from "@/components/manga/chapter-end"

<ChapterEnd
  chapter="Chapter 12 · Echo"
  next={{ number: 13, title: "Quiet Engine", href: "/read/13", cover: "/covers/13.jpg" }}
>
  <Button variant="outline" size="sm">Back to series</Button>
</ChapterEnd>

props.name: chapter
props.description: The chapter just read, shown as "End of {chapter}".

props.name: variant
props.description: continued: more to come (arrow) · end: the series is over (check).

props.name: next
props.type: { number, title, href?, onSelect?, cover?, date? }
props.description: The next chapter. Without href or onSelect it is not out yet and shows "Out on {date}".

props.name: children
props.description: Extra actions, in a wrapping row under the next chapter.
